A '''bridge''' over a [[Unidentified Naboo canyon|canyon]] lay at one end of [[Widow's Valley]]. It was bombed by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] to prevent [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Army C]] from crossing it.
